# Orbital Dodge

A simple HTML‑canvas game where the player pilots a spaceship orbiting a planet. Asteroids appear from random edges and follow curved trajectories. Tap/click to rotate the ship and dodge the hazards. **Lose condition:** three collisions with asteroids (or running out of shields) ends the game.

1: // Simple Orbital Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas element with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Resize canvas to fill its container
13:   const resize = () => {
14:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
15:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
16:     // Regenerate background stars for new size
17:     stars.length = 0;
18:     for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
19:       stars.push({
20:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
21:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
22:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
23:       });
24:     }
25:   };
26:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
27:   resize();
28:   // Generate background stars
29:   const stars = [];
30:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
31:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
32:     stars.push({
33:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
34:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
35:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
36:     });
37:   }
38: 
39:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
40:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
41:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on first user interaction
42:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
43:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', resumeAudio, { once: true });
44: 
45:   function playSound(freq, duration) {
46:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
47:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
48:     osc.type = 'sine';
49:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
50:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
51:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
52:     osc.start();
53:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
54:   }
55: 
56:   // Game constants
57:   const PLANET_RADIUS = 30;
58:   const ORBIT_RADIUS = 120; // distance from planet center
59:   const SHIP_SIZE = 12; // length of ship triangle
60:   const ROTATION_STEP = (Math.PI / 12); // 15 degrees per click
61:   const ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED = 0.7;
62:   const ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED = 1.5;
63:   const ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
64:   const MAX_LIVES = 3;
65: 
66:   // Game state
67:   let shipAngle = 0; // angle around planet
68:   let lives = MAX_LIVES;
69:   let lastSpawn = 0;
70:   const asteroids = [];
71:   let gameOver = false;
72: 
73:   // Helper: distance squared
74:   const dist2 = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => {
75:     const dx = x1 - x2;
76:     const dy = y1 - y2;
77:     return dx * dx + dy * dy;
78:   };
79: 
80:   // Ship position (computed each frame)
81:   const getShipPos = () => {
82:     const cx = canvas.width / 2;
83:     const cy = canvas.height / 2;
84:     const x = cx + ORBIT_RADIUS * Math.cos(shipAngle);
85:     const y = cy + ORBIT_RADIUS * Math.sin(shipAngle);
86:     return { x, y };
87:   };
88: 
89:   // Asteroid class
90:   class Asteroid {
91:     constructor() {
92:       // Spawn on a random edge
93:       const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
94:       const margin = 10;
95:       let x, y, vx, vy;
96:       const speed = ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED + Math.random() * (ASTEROID_MAX_SPEED - ASTEROID_MIN_SPEED);
97:       switch (edge) {
98:         case 0: // top
99:           x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
100:           y = -margin;
101:           break;
102:         case 1: // right
103:           x = canvas.width + margin;
104:           y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
105:           break;
106:         case 2: // bottom
107:           x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
108:           y = canvas.height + margin;
109:           break;
110:         case 3: // left
111:           x = -margin;
112:           y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
113:           break;
114:       }
115:       // Aim roughly toward the planet center with a slight random offset for curvature
116:       const targetX = canvas.width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
117:       const targetY = canvas.height / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80;
118:       const dx = targetX - x;
119:       const dy = targetY - y;
120:       const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
121:       vx = (dx / len) * speed;
122:       vy = (dy / len) * speed;
123:       this.x = x;
124:       this.y = y;
125:       this.vx = vx;
126:       this.vy = vy;
127:       this.radius = 8 + Math.random() * 6;
128:       // Random asteroid color
129:       this.color = `hsl(${Math.random() * 360}, 50%, 50%)`;
130:     }
131:     update(dt) {
132:       this.x += this.vx * dt;
133:       this.y += this.vy * dt;
134:     }
135:     draw() {
136:       ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
137:       ctx.beginPath();
138:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
139:       ctx.fill();
140:     }
141:   }
142: 
143:   // Input: click rotates ship clockwise
144:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
145:     if (gameOver) return;
146:     shipAngle += ROTATION_STEP;
147:     // Play short rotate sound
148:     playSound(400, 0.08);
149:   });
150: 
151:   // Main loop
152:   let lastTime = performance.now();
153:   function loop(now) {
154:     const dt = (now - lastTime) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps units
155:     lastTime = now;
156:     if (!gameOver) update(dt, now);
157:     render();
158:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
159:   }
160: 
161:   function update(dt, now) {
162:     // Spawn asteroids
163:     if (now - lastSpawn > ASTEROID_SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
164:       asteroids.push(new Asteroid());
165:       lastSpawn = now;
166:     }
167:     // Update asteroids
168:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
169:       const a = asteroids[i];
170:       a.update(dt);
171:       // Remove if far off-screen
172:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > canvas.width + 50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > canvas.height + 50) {
173:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
174:         continue;
175:       }
176:       // Collision with ship
177:       const shipPos = getShipPos();
178:       if (dist2(a.x, a.y, shipPos.x, shipPos.y) < (a.radius + SHIP_SIZE) ** 2) {
179:         lives--;
180:         playSound(200, 0.2); // collision sound
181:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
182:         if (lives <= 0) {
183:           gameOver = true;
184:           playSound(100, 0.5); // game over sound
185:         }
186:       }
187:     }
188:   }
189: 
190: function render() {
191:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
192:   // Draw background stars
193:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
194:   for (const s of stars) {
195:     ctx.beginPath();
196:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
197:     ctx.fill();
198:   }
199: 
200:   // Draw planet with gradient
201:   const cx = canvas.width / 2;
202:   const cy = canvas.height / 2;
203:   const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, PLANET_RADIUS * 0.2, cx, cy, PLANET_RADIUS);
204:   planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a90e2');
205:   planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0b3d91');
206:   ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
207:   ctx.beginPath();
208:   ctx.arc(cx, cy, PLANET_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
209:   ctx.fill();
210: 
211:   // Draw ship with gradient and slight outline
212:   const shipPos = getShipPos();
213:   const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-SHIP_SIZE, -SHIP_SIZE, SHIP_SIZE, SHIP_SIZE);
214:   shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#ffdd55');
215:   shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8800');
216:   ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
217:   ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
218:   ctx.lineWidth = 1;
219:   ctx.save();
220:   ctx.translate(shipPos.x, shipPos.y);
221:   ctx.rotate(shipAngle + Math.PI / 2); // point outward
222:   ctx.beginPath();
223:   ctx.moveTo(0, -SHIP_SIZE);
224:   ctx.lineTo(SHIP_SIZE / 2, SHIP_SIZE);
225:   ctx.lineTo(-SHIP_SIZE / 2, SHIP_SIZE);
226:   ctx.closePath();
227:   ctx.fill();
228:   ctx.stroke();
229:   ctx.restore();
230: 
231:   // Draw asteroids (colored already)
232:   for (const a of asteroids) a.draw();
233: 
234:   // Draw lives HUD
235:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
236:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
237:   ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, 10, 20);
238: 
239:   if (gameOver) {
240:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
241:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
242:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
243:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
244:     ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
245:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
246:   }
247: }
248: 
249:   // Start loop
250:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
251: })();

(End of file - total 251 lines)
</content>
